purpose: Select production-solver temporal controls against the same candidate-blind REF-HIGH accuracy targets before any performance timing. Timing is deliberately excluded so measured speed cannot influence accuracy matching or control selection.

ref_high_reconstruction.rule: Every P2E21A case must reproduce a valid 32-substep REF-HIGH endpoint before production configurations are interpreted. A reconstruction mismatch is provenance/reference failure, not a production-solver result.

common_outer_segmentation_ladder.definition: Each production configuration traverses the same 0.0016-day physical horizon as N equal accepted outer solver calls. Boundary forcing remains fixed at the initial-state-defined flux for the entire horizon. Candidate state from a valid segment becomes the next segment base state.
common_outer_segmentation_ladder.reason: Outer segmentation is a solver-independent temporal-control axis already representable by both routes. RossFast retains its frozen eight internal substeps inside each outer call; Reference retains its frozen production nonlinear controls.
common_outer_segmentation_ladder.on_invalid_segment: Stop that configuration at the first invalid segment, retain it as route-invalid, and do not substitute another control.

accuracy_metrics.transfer_metrics: Integrated top and bottom transfer identity over the complete horizon; under fixed prescribed flux these are hard consistency gates rather than a discriminating error axis.
accuracy_metrics.hard_mass_gate: absolute typed integrated mass residual <= 1e-12 cm on every accepted production segment

matched_accuracy_targets.storage_rule: Storage is NOT scaled with the target fraction. It must remain <= the full exact-Se P2E14 storage envelope at every target because that envelope is already at machine-scale summation resolution.
matched_accuracy_targets.definition: A production configuration meets target alpha only when all four head/theta discrepancies are <= alpha times their exact-Se P2E14 thresholds, storage discrepancy is <= the unscaled exact-Se P2E14 storage threshold, all route/mass/flux gates pass, and the complete horizon is traversed.
matched_accuracy_targets.scientific_meaning: alpha=1.0 is the frozen scientific admission envelope. alpha=0.5 and 0.25 are stricter work-precision analysis targets, not new scientific acceptance thresholds.

control_selection_rule.per_solver_case_target: Choose the least-refined valid outer segmentation, i.e. the smallest N segments in the frozen ladder, that meets the target.
control_selection_rule.reason: Selection is based only on satisfying a common scientific accuracy target. This prevents favorable runtime or algorithm-specific work accounting from influencing the matched-accuracy configuration.
control_selection_rule.if_no_configuration_meets_target: Mark solver-case-target UNRESOLVED_AT_TARGET. Do not extrapolate beyond 32 segments and do not drop the case.
control_selection_rule.paired_timing_population_future: A case-target enters P2E21B only if both REF_PROD and ROSS have a frozen selected configuration at that same target.

untimed_work_telemetry.interpretation: Algorithm-specific counters are reported as a vector. No arbitrary weighted conversion into one universal work unit is allowed.

primary_endpoints.E1: work-precision surface: scientific error versus outer segmentation for each solver and case
primary_endpoints.E2: selected least-refined configuration for each solver x case x matched-accuracy target
primary_endpoints.E3: paired availability count at each target
primary_endpoints.E4: route/retry failure structure across the common temporal-control ladder

secondary_endpoints: solver-specific work-counter vectors at every configuration
accuracy overshoot below the target for each selected configuration
REF_PROD versus ROSS error relative to REF-HIGH, never Ross-minus-Reference alone

future_P2E21B_timing_firewall.future_rule: Only configurations selected and persisted by P2E21A may be timed as matched-accuracy pairs.
future_P2E21B_timing_firewall.timing_order: must be separately preregistered with balanced/randomized order, warmup policy, repetition count and reporting statistic

required: exactly 6 outer segmentation levels for each of 2 production solvers
valid REF-HIGH reconstruction for every included case
no wall-clock or CPU timing used or emitted as an endpoint
all scientific failures retained rather than asserted as CI failures

hypothesis_mapping.SQ_H3: P2E21A does not test speed directly. It freezes matched-accuracy controls and determines whether a non-empty paired population exists on which computational advantage can be tested without accuracy confounding.

next_permitted_action: Implement and execute the full untimed 396-configuration P2E21A matrix plus REF-HIGH reconstruction. Do not time either production solver.
